title: Manufacturer Copay Card Carry-Forward Limit by Plan — Savings & Copay Assistance Programs
content:
The Manufacturer Copay Card carry-forward of the Savings & Copay Assistance Programs — the dollars left at a period's close times the carry-forward share, rounded to the cent half up — is held to the carry-forward limit. The limit follows the linked plan and the deductible the plan applied on the patient's paid claims dated fewer than 12 whole months before today.

| Linked plan (Prescription Insurance on File) | Deductible applied on paid claims in the last 12 whole months | Carry-forward limit |
|---|---|---|
| Commercial High-Deductible Health Plan | $2000.00 or more | $1000.00 |
| Commercial High-Deductible Health Plan | less than $2000.00 | $600.00 |
| Any other plan | any amount | $400.00 |

The plan is the class of the coverage record the card is linked to; the deductible is the deductible amounts on the patient's paid claims dated fewer than 12 whole months before today, added together.

**Hypothetical cards with a $735.00 carry-forward before the limit.**

- Commercial High-Deductible Health Plan, $2000.00 of deductible: limit $1000.00; $735.00 stands.
- Commercial High-Deductible Health Plan, $1999.99 of deductible: limit $600.00; held to $600.00.
- Commercial Copay Plan: limit $400.00; held to $400.00.
